name: Authentication & Authorization
description: Authentication & Authorization standard. Defines enforceable rules, implementation boundaries, failure handling and review evidence expected when STD-BE-AUTH applies.

rules.title: Authenticate using approved, verifiable credentials or tokens
rules.detail: Validate issuer/audience/signature/expiry for tokens and never trust identity claims from unverified client input.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Authenticate using approved, verifiable credentials or tokens.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Authenticate using approved, verifiable credentials or tokens.

rules.title: Authorize every protected operation at the server boundary
rules.detail: UI visibility is not authorization; enforce roles/permissions/policies and resource ownership before reading or mutating protected data.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Authorize every protected operation at the server boundary.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Authorize every protected operation at the server boundary.

rules.title: Use least privilege for users, services and machine credentials
rules.detail: Grant only required scopes/roles and separate service identities by responsibility/environment.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Use least privilege for users, services and machine credentials.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Use least privilege for users, services and machine credentials.

rules.title: Handle token/session lifecycle explicitly
rules.detail: Define expiration, refresh/rotation, revocation/logout and credential compromise behavior.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Handle token/session lifecycle explicitly.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Handle token/session lifecycle explicitly.

rules.title: Protect authentication endpoints from abuse
rules.detail: Apply rate limiting, lockout/risk controls and audit signals without enabling user enumeration.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Protect authentication endpoints from abuse.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Protect authentication endpoints from abuse.

rules.title: Audit sensitive authentication and authorization events
rules.detail: Record login/refresh/revocation/admin permission changes with safe correlation and without logging secrets.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Audit sensitive authentication and authorization events.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Audit sensitive authentication and authorization events.

integration_guide.title: Resolve applicability and dependencies
integration_guide.description: Confirm where STD-BE-AUTH applies and resolve its extends/implements/uses/aligns_with dependencies in the project standard profile.

integration_guide.title: Record project decisions
integration_guide.description: Apply the rules of Authentication & Authorization to requirements/design/ADRs and record any project-specific thresholds, providers or justified exceptions.

integration_guide.title: Implement with evidence
integration_guide.description: Implement the applicable MUST/SHOULD rules and link code, configuration, tests or review evidence to the change.

integration_guide.title: Verify before completion
integration_guide.description: Run automated checks where possible and manual review for judgement-based rules; close or approve documented deviations.

common_issues.issue: Authentication & Authorization is applied inconsistently across features
common_issues.cause: The project references the standard but does not resolve concrete ownership, thresholds or verification evidence.
common_issues.solution: Resolve dependencies, record project-specific decisions and include applicable rules in implementation/review checks.

common_issues.issue: Implementation satisfies the happy path but misses Authentication & Authorization failure cases
common_issues.cause: Boundary, retry, security or recovery scenarios were not included in acceptance/test planning.
common_issues.solution: Use the standard rules to add explicit failure/recovery scenarios and verify them before release.
